Win Tie Loss

Win tie loss using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

win_tie_loss(deltas, tolerance=0)

Example input

{
  "deltas": [
    0.5,
    0,
    -0.6
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "wins": 1,
  "ties": 1,
  "losses": 1
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py win_tie_loss < examples/win-tie-loss.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
